documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: PLA Metal
Bambu PLA Metal Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A02
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Metal
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 4.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2150 ± 180 MPa, bending strength 51 ± 5 MPa, impact 16.8 ± 1.2 kJ/m²) are not stored.

Printed-specimen results and raw-material properties stay apart: mechanical.* holds only printed-specimen values (with the specimen printing conditions in test_condition); material.density, thermal.melting_temp and thermal.glass_transition are material properties (ISO 1183, DSC). The TDS does not say how the Vicat (ISO 306) and HDT (ISO 75) specimens were made (its Specimen Test drawings cover tensile, bending and impact only); their test_condition says so. The registry has no separate *.printed / *.material keys.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2010 ± 220 MPa, Z 1710 ± 150 MPa), melt index (38.6 ± 3.7 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), saturated water absorption rate (0.40 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), max overhang angle (55 °), max bridging length (30 mm), spool material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 - 60 °C, 6 - 12 h), odor, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows. Not stored although a registry key exists: heat deflection temperature 62 °C at 0.45 MPa (thermal.heat_deflection_temp keeps the 1.8 MPa row, 58 °C) and chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (see the thermal.chamber_temp note).
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.

material.spool_type is the store bullet "Comes with Basic Reusable Spool" (unverified, scoped to the only Type value "Filament with spool"). The TDS Spool Material (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C) and Spool Size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm) rows give the spool's material and size, not its type; no registry key holds them.

The SDS model "A02-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : A02-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not stored: identity.model is written from the reviewed identity map ("PLA Metal", §C.1), which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace, and "A02-xx" is a designation with a wildcard suffix, not this product's model, so it must not become a search alias. SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source agreements: nozzle temperature (TDS 190 - 230 °C = material-table wiki row "PLA Metal" 190 - 230) and oven drying (TDS 55 °C, 8 h = material-table wiki row "PLA Metal / Wood / Marble" 55 ℃ for 8 h).

Source disagreements kept for review: bed temperature on the High Temperature and Textured PEI plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C for all three build plate types vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃); HDT (PLA wiki 57°C for PLA in general vs TDS 58 °C at 1.8 MPa and 62 °C at 0.45 MPa). The product TDS values are kept.
Marketing prose proves no number: "Relatively high impact strength" (store page) is not a value.
Hex: each of the 5 store colours ("<name> (<code>)") matches exactly one hex cell by name; the hex table prints names without the codes.

The store page links a certificate PDF that was not cached and not read: Filament RoHS (https://store.bblcdn.com/536ea9c19e434e78b3d8d4171baf8aef.pdf). The store page makes no certification claim of its own, so safety.certifications has no value and is not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament.

Adjudication against the second extraction (120 field disagreements): locator wording (the TDS rows, the hex cells, the Engineering Plate cell) keeps this file's form. thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (58 °C), as in every other filament file; the 0.45 MPa row (62 °C) is noted. material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure. The second extraction's material.spool_type (the TDS spool material and size) is replaced by the store bullet "Basic Reusable Spool" (see above). thermal.chamber_temp (see above), identity.model (see above) and compat.statement (the PLA wiki row is already the AMS-series, printer and nozzle relations) are not added. Relations keep this file's form: one AMS-series family relation (PLA wiki) rather than AMS and AMS lite relations, one "Open-frame or enclosed printer" relation rather than two printer-class relations, one standard-nozzle relation (TDS) rather than four, and the TDS Build Plate Type row for the Cool, High Temperature and Textured PEI plates (the material-table wiki and the store page say the same). Added after reading the material-table wiki and the TDS: compatible_with high-flow nozzles (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm), compatible_with Support for PLA and extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm) from the TDS Nozzle Size row (p.1), a registry key for every product type that other filament files also fill from their TDS Nozzle Size row; the same row stays the standard-nozzle relation. Second pass (2026-10-17): every disputed fact was re-read in the cached TDS (5 pages), SDS (pp.2, 4, 9), hex table, PLA wiki, material-table wiki and store page; the HDT, spool type, chamber temperature, SDS model and compat.statement decisions above stand.
